McDonald's Collection 2012

Released June 15, 2012 · 12 cards

Expanded

McDonald's Collection 2012 is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Other series, released in English on June 15, 2012. It has 12 cards. It includes 12 Pokémon, 0 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).
